Field Descriptions

LIMIT

APT proportion threshold for 3-bit samples. Maximum allowed count of most common 3-bit pattern in a 170-sample window. For unbiased source, expect ~21 (12.5%). Default=64 allows up to 38%. Reduce to ~28-32 to detect 3-bit pattern bias. Test fails if pattern count exceeds this limit.
